domain_title: Models, agents, providers, tools and supply chain
title: Agent autonomy and tool permissioning
canonical_definition: Agent authority is explicit, least-privilege, stage-appropriate, budgeted, observable and bounded by deterministic authorization for consequential actions.

conditions: Systems that plan, call tools, retrieve resources, communicate externally or modify records.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are each agent's tools, credentials, data access, action scope, budgets and approval points defined?
Are least privilege, deterministic authorization, reversibility, rate limits and interruption implemented outside model discretion?
Do negative tests and runtime evidence show that unauthorized, recursive or cross-boundary actions are prevented and detected?

conditions: Refer a material failure of agent autonomy and tool permissioning to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 3.3 (PDF p. 32), MAP 3.5 (PDF p. 32), MEASURE 2.7 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on scoping AI use, defining oversight and evaluating security and resilience. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make agent autonomy and tool permissioning verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: C3 evaluates agent autonomy and tool permissioning using evidence from intent through operation. AP-C3 independently assesses evidence of unbounded or implicit agent authority.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies an agent action register covering tool, identity, data, budget, scope, human approval and stop authority. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates external authorization and least privilege, bounded action and recursion limits, approved destinations, interruption and reversible handling where feasible. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides defensive policy tests and runtime records showing disallowed or unapproved actions are denied and escalated. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in agent autonomy and tool permissioning, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide an agent action register covering tool, identity, data, budget, scope, human approval and stop authority. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate external authorization and least privilege, bounded action and recursion limits, approved destinations, interruption and reversible handling where feasible. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide defensive policy tests and runtime records showing disallowed or unapproved actions are denied and escalated. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how agent autonomy and tool permissioning works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with an agent action register covering tool, identity, data, budget, scope, human approval and stop authority. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use defensive policy tests and runtime records showing disallowed or unapproved actions are denied and escalated to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: An agent may propose an action when an external control independently enforces authorization before execution.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-C3 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in agent autonomy and tool permissioning
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in agent autonomy and tool permissioning
Evidence remains insufficient for agent autonomy and tool permissioning in the assessed scope
